title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection, served with a nostalgic twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and allspice.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread slices on the grill or in a toaster.
Serve the lamb kebabs with toasted pita bread, chopped cucumber, and chopped tomato.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
